description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Clear functional corridor connecting zones. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: sofa against interior wall facing TV on the right exterior wall; armchair/coffee table grouping near the upper windows. Dining table (6 seats). TV on wall right of entry. Cook can see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Storage: one wardrobe. One bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: families with children; households needing a home office or desk space; roommates needing two private bedrooms.
not_suitable_for: households needing a home office or desk space
